result.summary: The intersection features a wide multi-lane roadway with no marked crosswalks or visible pedestrian signals, creating a hostile environment for people on foot. A pedestrian is seen crossing the wide expanse of asphalt without any dedicated infrastructure or protection from vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this large intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected path.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane road requires pedestrians to spend a significant amount of time exposed to traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a median refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time and reduce exposure.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane arterial road with overhead traffic signals but no visible marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals at the intersection. While sidewalks are present, the environment is dominated by vehicle traffic with long crossing distances and minimal pedestrian protection.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated path and reducing driver awareness.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic, increasing their exposure time to vehicles in a high-speed environment.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian-specific signal heads are visible, making it difficult for pedestrians to know when it is safe to cross.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on remaining crossing time.

interventions.title: Raised Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Convert the painted median into a raised refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross in stages and provide physical protection.
